referenceMethod: Python standard-library integer reference arithmetic over all 256 cells, using unchanged v0.2 rules; not Unity execution.

reproduction.scriptRole: Scratch design arithmetic; not shipped runtime and not an independent implementation oracle.
reproduction.startingState: Each single case, combined case, stress case and seed run starts from the same expanded map; no state passes between cases.
reproduction.time: 40 tick updates per resolved round; no idle or background updates.
reproduction.rules: simulation-profile.v0.2.json and SIMULATION.md provide every field, flow, outlet, absorption, evaporation and growth formula; GAMEPLAY.md provides local need and mapping weights.
reproduction.numericType: Python integers with state-range assertions. C# checked Int64 overflow behaviour is not exercised.
reproduction.fixtureRoundId: caseId + :round: + decimalRoundNumber; cases use single-{recipeId}, the combined id, stress-{recipeId}, or seed-{seed}.

finalStateNumericEncoding.rows: 256 rows in cellId order, followed by one [tickIndex,roundCount] row.
finalStateNumericEncoding.encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON integer/null arrays; no whitespace or trailing newline.
finalStateNumericEncoding.notWorldSnapshotStateHash: Plant IDs, origin metadata and cumulative ledgers are excluded; this diagnostic hash is not JCS(WorldSnapshot), a journal hash, or a content hash.

measurementDefinitions.waterBalance: After-before = injected - drained - surfaceEvaporated - soilEvaporated on every tick; infiltration is an internal transfer.
measurementDefinitions.absorbed: Cumulative surface-to-soil transfer, distinct from final soil-water gain.
measurementDefinitions.transport: Sum of positive directed edge transfers across ticks; repeated motion is counted and this is not unique water volume or path provenance.
measurementDefinitions.maxSurfaceDepth: Maximum cell surface water after injection and before flow, or initial round state; maxPostTickSurfaceDepth samples after the complete tick.
measurementDefinitions.growthDelta: Sum of integer growth gains over all plants, including new seeds; fractional remainders persist.
measurementDefinitions.roundsWithoutIntegerGrowth: No whole growth unit added anywhere in that round; water/soil changes and animation may still exist.
measurementDefinitions.stageCounts: Only the four growth-threshold events are counted here; this is not the total runtime event count.
measurementDefinitions.observationEdgeTransfers: Per-round sum only in each listed directed edge; zero means no positive transfer on that edge in the round.

calibration.type: Map authoring calibration, not independent out-of-sample validation.
calibration.reason: The first draft absorbed the same 35 units at light-bud in each of two consecutive water_drop rounds. A shallow inlet makes its limited storage visible without changing outcome entropy.
calibration.interpretation: A local cumulative absorption difference, not proof of a particular water path and not a guarantee that later input always travels farther.

fixtureSummary.initialBudCaveatJa: 初期つぼみをgrowth=1700で置き、各投で庭全体が40tick進む。光入力の外でも基礎光で成長するため、この16列の2〜3投での最初の開花には初期配置と基礎成長が寄与する。祈り・カードの効果や実プレイでの成功率の証明ではない。
fixtureSummary.samplingCaveatJa: seed集合を先に固定して全16列を掲載したが、同じ集合をmap調整にも用いた設計参照であり、独立した検証標本ではない。

fixtureSampling.descriptionJa: 補正していない設計参照列。実プレイの成功率・開花時刻を保証する標本ではない。
fixtureSampling.derivation: For each role independently: concatenate SHA-256 of ASCII quiet-basin-v03|seed={seed}|round={round}|role={role}|block={block}, starting block=0; take mapping256/outcome32/oracle32 bytes.
fixtureSampling.integerFormatting: Seeds 0..15, rounds 1..24, blocks 0..; decimal ASCII without leading zeroes or trailing newline.
fixtureSampling.conversion: mapping: big-endian uint32 rejection UniformBelow; n=1 consumes no bytes; for n>1 reject x >= 2^32-(2^32 mod n). outcome/oracle: first byte<252, then 1+byte%6.
fixtureSampling.mappingOrder: Complete 3 distinct family draws first; choose each selected family recipe in family draw order; choose the remaining 3 recipes sequentially under caps; Fisher-Yates i=5..1, j=UniformBelow(i+1). All draws consume one mapping buffer from the start.
fixtureSampling.candidateOrder: Families use familyOrder; recipes use recipeIndexOrder; preserve that order after filtering. A single weighted candidate still consumes UniformBelow(sumWeights).
fixtureSampling.faceRecipeIndexStrings: Six characters for die faces 1..6, each character is a zero-based recipeIndexOrder index.
fixtureSampling.noOutcomeConditioning: No reroll or seed selection for growth, intention, oracle card, message or visual result. State-based recipe weights follow GAMEPLAY.md.

notCovered: water molecule provenance or verified path to a particular root
acceptanceMeaning: Arithmetic properties and fixture outcomes only; no guarantee of a particular normal-play outcome or bloom time.
